configuration_proof.critic: --critic codex and --critic-model gpt-6-astra explicitly override automatic choice; all writers Claude, so no same-vendor fallback
configuration_proof.effort: config.efforts.codex.critic=high -> resolveCritic.effort_requested -> criticArgs.effort -> codex flags -c model_reasoning_effort="high"
configuration_proof.cost_limit: Config critic_caps.max_usd_per_call=3 is passed but Codex adapter does not accept/enforce it. USD null; no hard dollar/token cap.
configuration_proof.model_limit: Requested identity fixed; model_actual may be null. Aggregate metadata does not prove each intermediate served identity. Report known limitation; reported mismatch stops further pairs.

accounting.retry: Automatic once after adapter failure/throw or invalid response; no whole-pair retry, no separate reversed command. A disappointing valid judgment never triggers retry.
accounting.cost_collection: Read calls,usage,cost_usd from pair or pair_failed ledger row and failure.json costs on failure. Null cost is unknown, not zero. known_cost_usd subtotal available in failure evidence.

procedure: Before each pair: verify source file hashes, fixed config/CLI/subscription route, canary matching current recipe, and both completed run identities/harness/input metadata. Do not inspect prose for selection.

Snapshot ledger byte length/hash and existing pair directory names. Write invocation journal start including exact argv, expected slots, limits and source hashes. Execute only after separate driver GO; sequential pair invocations and no concurrent ledger-mutating writer invocation preferred.

Capture stdout/stderr and exit code. Identify exactly one new ledger pair/pair_failed row matching both run IDs; preserve that row verbatim and its byte offset, pair_id and path. A failure before pair creation may have no row: retain exit/log and directory delta, stop for reconciliation.

Hash and retain complete new evals/pairs/PAIR_ID directory including A/B story+SVG copies,mapping.json,critique-AB.json,critique-BA.json,critique.md on success; failure.json and any successful partial order file on failure. Keep mapping/critic outcomes outside manual reviewer packets.

Hash run.json/checks.json references and pin source artifacts without modifying them. Keep ledger snapshot/delta and invocation log hashes, started/ended time,requested/actual model,requested effort,CLI version,calls/usage/nullable cost.

For a successful row validate calls between3 and6,critic vendor codex/model gpt-6-astra/effort_requested high,rubric story/v2 and exact hash. For pair_failed allow fewer calls, retain every attempt count/error and partial result. Sum actual calls against24 pair allowance.
Keep runtime AB/BA results sealed until independent manual readings/codes freeze. No owner mapping reveal before actual response capture; missing owner response remains missing.
stop_handling: Do not run commands containing PENDING placeholders.
Any nonzero exit or pair_failed row stops new pair commands for driver assessment; never rerun that pair automatically.
Any wrong identity/changed source hash,repeated pair row,missing accounting,reported served-model mismatch or attempt count exceeding6 stops new calls.
If interrupted, preserve directory/ledger/logs; running attempt may have spent resources without final accounting. No retry until reconciled and no additional call authorized by this file.
Successful pair aggregate tie may mean both ties or order disagreement; retain both original judgments and derive strict interpretation later. Incomplete order is missing, not a tie.
discrepancies_and_limits: Six-call reservation must include reader-question retries; four pair commands already give eight order judgments.
Frozen pair command has no image-render flag for paired critique: runtime critic sees SVG/text; manual PNG reading is separate.

No separate reader-questions.json written on success; questions are represented in successful judgment reader-question fields. Failure.json includes questions and question prompt hash. Do not promise full raw question-response retention.
Invalid retry response text is not retained; per-attempt raw audit unavailable.

Pinned pair CLI wraps pairRuns in try/finally writeReport, so report refresh is attempted after pairRuns success or failure. Pre-pair argument/config/run-resolution/critic-availability failure occurs before that try and does not refresh; a report-write failure can leave stale output or replace the surfaced error. Ledger and retained pair/failure artifacts remain primary evidence.
All artifacts reside in execution worktree, not automatically in root repository. Driver must archive owned evidence preserving hashes without copying private mappings into reviewer packets.
Plan pair order is q01r1,q01r2,q03r1,q03r2; pending run IDs filled mechanically from finish metadata without changing pairing.
